## Navigation / Registry Checklist

## Navigation Rollback Checklist

- [ ] Revert source navigation changes before generated outputs.
- [ ] Regenerate docs navigation after rollback.
- [ ] Regenerate artifact hash manifest if registry or registered files changed.
- [ ] Re-run docs navigation, artifact and security gates.
